measuring-length-skill-01.target: I can compare two lengths and put three objects in order from shortest to longest.
measuring-length-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can compare two lengths and put three objects in order from shortest to longest.
measuring-length-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Comparing objects that do not start at the same line. Try this: Line up the ends before comparing.

measuring-length-skill-02.target: I can use a third object to compare two lengths.
measuring-length-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can use a third object to compare two lengths.
measuring-length-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Thinking a comparison cannot be made without putting the two objects side by side. Try this: If the rug is longer than the string and the string is longer than the desk, the rug is longer than the desk.

measuring-length-skill-03.target: I can measure a length by counting same-size units laid end to end.
measuring-length-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can measure a length by counting same-size units laid end to end.
measuring-length-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Counting the spaces or lines instead of the units. Try this: Count each cube or paper clip as you touch it.

measuring-length-skill-04.target: I can tell when a measurement is wrong because of gaps, overlaps, or units of different sizes.
measuring-length-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can tell when a measurement is wrong because of gaps, overlaps, or units of different sizes.
measuring-length-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Leaving gaps or overlaps, or mixing big and small units. Try this: Check that units touch end to end and are all the same size.
